project_context: Rheos — experimental Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) iOS app. SwiftUI + MVVM with Combine, iOS 17+, Swift 5.9.

agents.name: researcher
responsibilities: Research APIs, protocols, frameworks before implementation
Investigate codebase patterns to maintain consistency
Find existing solutions / prior art
Document findings clearly for architect

agents.name: system-architect
responsibilities: Plan code structure before implementation
Define interfaces, protocols, and data flow
Identify failure modes (BLE disconnect, sensor noise, edge cases)
Specify error handling strategy
Validate architectural consistency with existing codebase

agents.name: mobile-dev
responsibilities: Implement features according to architect's plan
Idiomatic Swift, no force-unwraps
Strong typing — leverage Swift's type system
Structured error handling — typed errors, no silent catches
All public APIs documented with /// doc comments

agents.name: algorithm-engineer
responsibilities: Design and implement prediction algorithms
Implement adaptive ISF / carb ratio learners
Implement biometric modifier modules
Implement caffeine and meal extension models
Document mathematical rationale for every formula
Provide reference papers / sources for chosen approaches
must_address: Numerical stability across realistic input ranges
Behavior at edge cases (sensor dropout, missing data)
Validation strategy (shadow mode, comparison to known systems)

agents.name: tester
responsibilities: Write unit tests for new functions
Property-based tests for data parsing and algorithms
Edge cases: malformed input, disconnect mid-operation, time zone shifts
UI tests for critical flows
Test fixtures with realistic + extreme ranges

agents.name: reviewer
responsibilities: Review code changes
Check for retain cycles in closures
Verify @MainActor usage for UI updates
Validate Combine subscription cleanup
Confirm no force-unwraps slipped through
Check error handling completeness
Verify documentation on public APIs
review_checklist: No implicitly unwrapped optionals where avoidable
All public APIs have /// doc comments
All async work properly handles cancellation
All Combine subscriptions stored or properly scoped
No print() in production code paths

agents.name: security-auditor
responsibilities: Review networking, auth, persistence, logging changes
Verify glucose/health data is encrypted at rest
Confirm no PHI in logs or analytics
Validate API keys / secrets not hardcoded
Check OAuth flows for Whoop/Aura/Dexcom
Review Keychain usage for credentials
Audit before sending data to LLM APIs
must_check: Are glucose values encrypted in persistent storage?
Is the encryption key stored in Keychain (not UserDefaults)?
Are network requests using HTTPS only?
Is certificate pinning needed for medical APIs?
Before LLM call: is data minimized? user consented?
Is biometric auth used for sensitive actions?

agents.name: perf-engineer
responsibilities: Audit battery impact (BLE polling, HR streams, location)
Profile main thread blocking
Validate background task budgets
Optimize chart rendering for high-frequency data

feature_pipeline.flow: researcher → system-architect → mobile-dev → tester → reviewer + security-auditor

memory_namespaces.patterns: Reusable code patterns and architectural decisions
memory_namespaces.ble-quirks: Dexcom G7 / Omnipod BLE quirks discovered during dev
memory_namespaces.wearable-apis: Notes on Whoop / Aura / HealthKit API behaviors

battery_check.trigger: after BLE or background task changes

spawning_template.description: Template for spawning a coordinated team for a new feature

example_feature.prompt: Research [TOPIC] in our codebase and external docs. Note existing patterns. SendMessage findings to 'system-architect'.
Wait for 'researcher'. Design solution for [FEATURE]. Address: connectivity loss, malformed data, threading, persistence. SendMessage plan to 'mobile-dev'.
Wait for 'system-architect'. Implement per plan. SendMessage to 'tester' when done.
Wait for 'mobile-dev'. Write XCTest unit tests + property-based tests. Cover edge cases. SendMessage to 'reviewer' AND 'security-auditor' in parallel.
Wait for 'tester'. Run review_checklist. Check retain cycles, threading, force-unwraps.
Wait for 'tester'. Run must_check list. Verify encryption, PII handling, auth flows.
